descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S04 「养老院：一次存档的就诊收起列出，带行数，展开显示它的文字」 Nursing Home: an archived visit is listed collapsed with its line count and expands to its text

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 The physician can open Prior Encounter Transcripts for a patient, and the prior encounters are listed there automatically.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 How it works 2；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 3；TFA-92594 How it works 3）
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 4；TFA-92594 How it works 4）
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both.（UAT 3.3；TFA-92594 AC 2）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Tim's chromium test: SNF resident with one archived row 'Sep 23 · Visit notes' (1 line) set through snf:update

When Open the resident's Encounter tab and expand the row

Then 'Prior Encounter Transcripts' visible; row shows '1 lines' with the text hidden; after the tap the visit text is visible and aria-expanded is true

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions: visitRow toContainText '1 lines', text toBeHidden, then toBeVisible after the click (U3, U4, U8). The row is seeded directly, so this proves neither the Nursing Home rotation nor the two-visit rule (S11)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S04

Nursing Home: an archived visit is listed collapsed with its line count and expands to its text

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-16.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • prior-transcripts.spec.ts [chromium] — a nursing-home resident's archived visit is listed on the Encounter tab — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec e2e/prior-transcripts.spec.ts, chromium): it signs in a fresh @roundai.test account through e2e/support (local admin key) and writes the archived visit row with createSnfResident + snf:update from the test; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on t…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
